# packages/sdk/src

TypeScript source for @prosodyai/sdk, the consumer SDK for the ProsodyAI API.

## Files

- `index.ts`: public export surface.
- `types.ts`, `types/`: wire payload types; wire field names are confined here.
- `step.ts`: `AcousticWindow`, one measured interval; readable accessors
  (`getProsody`, `getMeasurement`, `getChange`, `getPitch`, `getLevel`,
  `getVoicing`, `getTilt`, `getVad`) plus the raw wire escape hatches
  (`getAcousticState`, `getAcousticChange`).
- `analysis.ts`: batch envelope validation and `ConversationAnalysis`.
- `conversation.ts`: `Conversation`, shared live/batch state model.
- `transcription.ts`: `Speaker`, `VoiceProfile`, `Transcription`.
- `conversation/prosody.ts`: owns the readable measurement names
  (`Prosody`, `ProsodyChange`, `MeasurementName`) and the only
  readable-to-wire key maps.
- `client.ts`, `session.ts`, `live-session.ts`, `realtime.ts`: transports.

## Contracts

- Product surface carries readable names (`pitchHz`, `loudnessDbfs`).
  Wire names (`f0_median_hz`, `rms_dbfs`) appear only in `types/` and in the
  maps inside `conversation/prosody.ts`.
- Wire names that cross the delta boundary are mapped through `CHANGE_WIRE`;
  the readable change keys are `loudnessDb`, `pitchSemitones`, and friends.
